simple.meaning: שִׁלֻּחָה (shilluchâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a shoot.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

firstOccurrence.englishText: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

definitions.full: H7976. shilluchah or sheluchah [ שְׁלוּחָה ] noun feminine shoot, branch (compare I. שֶׁלַח 2 ); — plural suffix שְׁלוּחֹתֶיהָ Isa 16:8 , of vine of Sibmah (east of Jordan).
